versionImpact.rationale: Buildchain 4.1 separates the public workflow API from the selected execution runtime. Runtime inputs, owned callers, locks and recovery contracts change together without historical compatibility paths.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: Every public entry selects runtime-ref over the selected consumer contract lock over the entry default. The sole prepare action acquires and activates the chosen runtime in every execution job; all business actions, modules and WASM execute from that distribution.

A new execution can select a repaired train while preserving the original consumer source and valid build checkpoints or sealed release candidates. Downstream runtime SHA comparisons are removed; source, artifact, provider readback and publication authorization remain enforced.

Buildchain dogfood and external consumers use the same floating workflow entries and runtime preparation. Paper scaffold and migration write floating callers with current contract locks. Retired runtime actions, alternate checkouts and selector aliases are removed.

summary: Buildchain v4.1 alpha.1 unifies runtime selection and preparation across public workflows, separates entry and execution versions, and supports repaired-train recovery with retained source and artifact evidence. Business nodes no longer compare Buildchain SHAs. Entry failures require a published entry upgrade and a fresh complete run.
